text:
Ivy: Heads up 9. Rented a car for client visits in Madrid. At drop-off they charged a €45 fuel prepay on the corpcard but their kiosk lost the printed receipt. Rental agreement shows the charge but no receipt image. Can we still expense and reclaim VAT?

Marta: Ouch. We need a vendor receipt or merchant statement ideally. Do you have the rental agreement PDF and the corpcard transaction line? Also confirm if fuel prepay is refundable (many vendors refund unused fuel).

Ivy: Uploaded rental_agreement_2069009999.pdf and card_tx_2069009999.png to files.redwood. Vendor said they issued the charge but cannot reprint a receipt; they offered an emailed invoice number INV-5542 that should show the breakdown but they need our billing address to reissue.

Procurement: Note: vendor must provide an invoice with VAT reg no for reclaim. If they can't provide VAT invoice, classify as non-reclaimable. Also check vendor policy on prepaid fuel refunds; if refunded we should net it against the charge.

Marta: For processing, do the following in the expense portal:
- Attach rental agreement PDF and card transaction screenshot
- Add note: "vendor ref INV-5542 - reissue requested to Redwood Inference Ltd, VAT GB123456789"
- Temp code GL 6501 Travel - fuel prepay (pending invoice).
If vendor emails the invoice, AP will move to VAT reclaim workflow. If no invoice in 7 business days, expense stays non-reclaimable and will be coded to GL 6559.

Ivy: Sent vendor my billing address and VAT reg no earlier today. I also flagged for refund check: they said refunds processed within 10 days if unused. If refunded, I'll attach the refund transaction.

finance-bot: Automated checklist: required docs -> vendor invoice with VAT line, vendor VAT reg no, card txn, rental agreement. Missing currently: VAT invoice. Action items assigned: Ivy to follow up vendor; Marta/AP to monitor for invoice/refund. Thread closed by finance-bot: will re-open if vendor provides invoice or refund.
